mapper.select: SELECT SANCTIONS_ID, USER_ID, SANCTIONS_TYPES, SANCTIONS_START_DATE, SANCTIONS_END_DATE, SANCTIONS_REASON, ADMIN_ACCOUNT_ID, SANCTIONS_CREATED_AT FROM sanctions
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sanctions(USER_ID, SANCTIONS_TYPES, SANCTIONS_START_DATE, SANCTIONS_END_DATE, SANCTIONS_REASON, ADMIN_ACCOUNT_ID, SANCTIONS_CREATED_AT) VALUES(#{userId}, #{sanctionsType}, #{sanctionsStartDate}, #{sanctionsEndDate}, #{sanctionsReason}, #{adminAccountId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sanctions SET SANCTIONS_TYPES = #{sanctionsType}, SANCTIONS_START_DATE = #{sanctionsStartDate}, SANCTIONS_END_DATE = #{sanctionsEndDate}, SANCTIONS_REASON = #{sanctionsReason}, ADMIN_ACCOUNT_ID = #{adminAccountId}, SANCTIONS_CREATED_AT = #{sanctionsCreatedAt} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
